text.p: Elek-Tek Inc said Thursday it reached agreement on modified terms and conditions of its revolving credit facility which allow the company to comply with the terms and conditions of its bank credit pact.
Elek-Tek reached agreement with Deutsche Financial Services Corporation, a unit of Deutsche Bank Group, and NationsCredit Commercial Corp of America, a NationsBank affiliate.

Elek-Tek said the amount has been reduced to $39 million from $50 million, which will result in lower bank commitment fees being paid by the company. The smaller credit facility reflects inventory management improvements by the company. Currently, $20 million is outstanding.
The renegotiated terms include an amended termination date of January 2, 1998.
Elek-Tek markets microcomputer products and services.
